PR-001.reason: LocalRpcGuardMiddleware is the outermost ASGI layer of the rpc_v2 HttpServer. A loopback peer needs a loopback Host (403 local_rpc_host_forbidden stops DNS rebinding) and, when it sends Origin, a contract dashboard origin (loopback hosts x nexus_dash_frontend/pycore_backend/PYCORE_UI_PORT; 403 local_rpc_origin_forbidden). A non-loopback peer needs a valid K3 signature over the buffered body (401 client_key_*). CORS lists only those origins with allow_credentials False (no *), and access-control-allow-private-network is sent only for an allowed origin. The bind resolves to loopback unless system_settings.rpcLanBind is true (network_constants, pythreadpool starters, pyservice.ps1 -BindHost). Relay operations run in-process, unchanged. A foreign web page or LAN host can no longer drive terminals.

PR-021.reason: thread_bus/trigger_event admits only voice_subtitle mode enter/exit (new BusSignals, also used by the PySide6 bridge) with an empty payload; every other event name returns event_name_forbidden. The route sits behind K7.

PR-030.reason: ui/video_extract/open hands only video, audio-codec and subtitle files to the OS handler (by resolved suffix); scripts, executables and launchers are refused, and directories still open. An output-root allowlist is not applied because source videos are user-picked; K7 gates the caller. The finding's code-execution scenario is closed.

PR-031.reason: Every route is behind K7. Books extraction is limited to BOOK_EXTENSIONS. set_system_settings type-checks the keys pycore acts on. Client-supplied Laravel base URLs (audio_orch login, audio_lane_full_sync, queue_center accept_task) must be catalog endpoints (is_catalog_endpoint, LARAVEL_ENDPOINT_UNKNOWN), so pycore never logs in to or signs for an arbitrary host.

PR-037.reason: Clipboard text is never logged (lengths only) in clipboard_monitor, clipboard_sync and background_services, and the monitor start route is behind K7.

AT-006.reason: f5tts writes the reference audio as the fixed stem 'ref' plus a sanitized extension (no client path), and binds 127.0.0.1 by default; the launcher passes the loopback host.

AT-029.reason: The launcher passes CHATTTS/F5TTS host and port (loopback default), and the chattts, f5tts, fishspeech and qwen3tts servers default to 127.0.0.1. Residual: CosyVoice's upstream server hardcodes 0.0.0.0 (upstream clone, recorded).

okx reveal_credentials (frontend-ui cros.reason: No okx/* handler or route name exists in pycore/ or pyapps/ (my own grep during vortex-4 agrees). The UI no longer calls it (vortex-4), and pyapps/okx_price_monitor uses the shared HttpServer, so K7 applies.

issues: pycore/pyutils/rpc_v2/http/local_rpc_middleware.py:31 (non-blocking) scopes whose type is not 'http' pass ungated. Only lifespan exists today (no websocket routes in pycore), but gate or refuse 'websocket' scopes so a future WS route cannot bypass K7.

local_rpc_middleware.py _read_body (non-blocking) buffers a non-loopback body without a size cap before K3 verification. Cap it at the server's payload limit so an unsigned LAN peer cannot make pycore hold an arbitrary body.
(cross-scope, shell) scripts/shells/linux/common/pyservice_entry.sh still passes --host 0.0.0.0; pycore downgrades it to loopback without rpcLanBind, but the default should change on the shell side.

Same line-ending churn as pycore-1 (rpc_v2/server.py, thread_bus_bridge.py, video_extract_service.py, network_constants.py, starters.py, TTS servers). Restore per-line endings from HEAD. f5tts_api_server.py and tts_service_manager.py also carry pycore-4 hunks (AT-030, AT-005/AT-032), which are not covered here.
